question: What function is ascribed to the seventh circle when addressed to the goddess as supreme and army-paralyzing?
premises: The seventh circle is addressed to the goddess.
It is described as making the army paralyzed.
inference: The seventh circle is the supreme circle that paralyzes an army.
uncertainties: The mode of its operation is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: The seventh circle, O goddess, is supreme and makes the army paralyzed.
